West Bengal may soon be renamed Paschim Banga as the state government prepares to introduce a resolution in the Assembly.
But can a state change its name on its own? Why was the name West Bengal adopted in the first place? And what happened to the earlier proposal to rename the state as Bangla?
This explainer looks at the political, historical and constitutional aspects of the proposed name change, the role of Parliament, and how similar renaming exercises have taken place in other parts of India.
Thank you for watching our video!
